description: One question for the owner. Size cap: 64 KB (see spec).

askedAt.description: When the card was first asked.

batch.description: Batch id this card belongs to, if any.

blocks.description: What waits on the answer, or null for nothing waits on this.

exception.description: Rule of the owner this card loosens, or null. Shown before anything else.

label.description: Short id the owner can quote; never reused or relabelled.

multiple.description: Whether the owner may pick more than one option.

neededBy.description: Deadline for the answer, or null.

at.description: When the answer is needed by, or null when there is no date.

ifNoAnswer.description: What happens or starts costing without an answer.

now.description: The situation today, in plain words.

nowAsOf.description: When the counts in now were true.

oldAnswer.description: Any earlier answer quoted because the premise moved, or null.

at.description: When the earlier answer was given.

options.description: 2 to 4 options, each with what the owner gets and what it costs.

gets.description: What the owner gets from the option.

image.description: Option image in the writer's own folder (PNG, JPEG or WebP, at most 2 MB), or null.

reason.description: Why the card was withdrawn, e.g. Settled by your note.

recommendation.description: The agent's recommended option, or null.

replies.description: The agent's replies to the owner's notes on this card.

t3Thread.description: Asker's T3 thread id, or null.

reversible.description: Whether the decision is reversible, or null.

seq.description: Increases on every write by this writer.

state.description: Card state. Answered comes only from answers/.

stream.description: Stream id within the project, e.g. F.

supersededBy.description: Card id that supersedes this one.

urgency.description: How soon the answer is needed; the spec shows today.

whatChanged.description: What changed since the earlier asking, or null.
